text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Look at that girl! See, she's just 
entering the home stretch—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Wah! Such sharp movement...! ...There 
really are so many amazing girls at the 
Academy."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because she pays such close attention to 
her surroundings, she seemed to lose a bit 
of confidence over the gap. However—
choice_data_list:
Dantsu, how should I run to sharpen my 
kick?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh? ...Ah, umm. ...Maintain pace so I can 
have a sharp burst of speed?
choice_data_list: How can I maintain this, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe core strength? If your body's 
core is steady, you won't waste stamina. 
You can also maintain the posture best 
suited for you...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could maintain my form just 
like she does...?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's copy them and give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... How was... my time...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, this is what I should have done all 
along. Instead of looking at the others 
and moping around.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Because... that would be such a waste!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please, one more time! I feel 
like I can run way, way faster next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Dantsu Flame continued running 
until it was dark all around.
